Annotation.String: An agent execution context. ConfigType is Local or Modal. Local requires NetworkingType=Unrestricted and forbids AllowMcpServers/AllowPackageManagers. Modal provisions a remote sandbox via Modal.com and uses the ModalImage/ModalCpu/ModalMemory/ModalTimeout columns for configuration.
A managed agent. ModelSpeed (optional) must be `standard` or `fast`. Version is client-managed — increment on every PATCH. Archived is terminal.
Kind is `agent_toolset`, `mcp_toolset`, or `custom`. `custom` requires Name/Description/InputSchema. `mcp_toolset` requires McpServerName. `agent_toolset` forbids all kind-specific fields.
Declares which other agents a coordinator can delegate to via delegate_to_agent. CalleeAgentId references the target ManagedAgent.
A managed agent session. Requires a pre-existing ManagedAgent and Environment. Lifecycle: Rescheduling → Running → Idle → Terminated → Archived. Archive requires TerminateSession first.
A sub-agent execution thread within a multi-agent session. Created implicitly by the responder during delegation. Lifecycle: Running → Idle → Running (resumable) or → Terminated.
Kind is `github_repository`, `file`, or `memory_store`. github_repository requires Url; file requires FileId; memory_store requires MemoryStoreId. Access is read_write or read_only.

Append-only event log. Kind is one of 20 dot-notation values across user/agent/session/span groups. Queryable scalars include ToolUseId, ToolName, McpServerName, CustomToolUseId, McpToolUseId, StopReason, ErrorKind, ModelRequestStartId, and token-usage counts; Content holds the full opaque payload. SessionThreadId scopes events to a delegation thread.
A named collection of text memories. Attach to sessions via SessionResource with Kind=memory_store. Active → Archived lifecycle.
A text document at a file-like Path inside a MemoryStore. Content up to 100KB. ContentSha256 for optimistic concurrency.
Immutable audit record. Operation is created/modified/deleted. RedactVersion clears content while preserving metadata.
Cron schedule that posts a user.message to a Session at the specified interval. Trigger action fires the crucible_cron_trigger WASM module.
Per-tenant heartbeat that checks active SessionSchedules every N seconds and fires due ones. Self-scheduling via WASM heartbeat loop.
Archive an environment. Retains history but makes the environment non-operational. Archived is terminal.
Archive a managed agent. Mirrors Anthropic's POST /v1/agents/{id}/archive. Archived is terminal.
Transition a rescheduled session to Running after the runtime has placed it on an environment.
Mark a running session as Idle when the agent yields.
Resume an idle session back to Running.
Pause a running or idle session and mark it for rehoming onto a new environment.
Terminate a session. Mirrors Anthropic's implicit cleanup semantics. Clients should set TerminatedAt.
Archive a memory store. Prevents new memory writes. Existing memories are preserved read-only.
Redact a memory version. Clears Content, ContentSha256, ContentSizeBytes, and Path while preserving Operation, MemoryId, SessionId, and timestamps.
Archive a terminated session. Mirrors Anthropic's POST /v1/sessions/{id}/archive but requires TerminateSession first. Archived is terminal.
Mark a running thread as Idle when the sub-agent yields.
Resume an idle thread back to Running.
Terminate the thread when the sub-agent finishes its delegated task.
